description: Frontend Pro-VC Dashboard improvements. Depends on FEAT-001 at runtime (calls GET/POST /api/provc-comments/:reportId). Touches frontend only (disjoint from FEAT-001's backend files). Build the shared right-side Pro-VC comment panel; switch both FFI charts (VCDashboard InlineAnalysis + SubmissionDetail Full View) to FULL faculty names with the requested 2-band legend; add per-row Pro-VC Comments buttons in the Analytics Need-Attention section; redesign the Full View and add an Action Taken button + Pro-VC Comments buttons (header + per-row) there. Reuse existing APIs (PATCH /api/submissions/:id/action-taken for Action Taken) and the shared api client. React + Tailwind only; no new libraries; no dummy data.
steps: Create src/components/ProVCCommentPanel.jsx: a right-side slide-over panel rendered via createPortal(..., document.body) (same portal pattern as src/components/CommentEditor.jsx). Props: { open, onClose, reportId, facultyName, subjectCode, courseName, academicYear }. Import the shared axios client: `import api from '../api';` and `import toast from 'react-hot-toast';` and icons from 'lucide-react' (e.g. X, Save, MessageSquare). When open && reportId, GET `/api/provc-comments/${reportId}` and store `comments` in state (loading + error states). Header shows the faculty name and course (facultyName + subjectCode, courseName as subtitle) at the top. Body lists existing comments with authorName + relative/short createdAt date; show an empty-state message when none. Footer: a controlled <textarea> and a Save button. Save -> POST `/api/provc-comments/${reportId}` with body { text, facultyName, subjectCode, courseName, academicYear }; clear the textarea on success, toast.success('Comment saved'), and re-fetch the list; toast.error on failure. Never render hardcoded/dummy comments. Panel is a fixed right-0 overlay with a backdrop; closed by onClose / X / Escape. Export default.

Modify src/pages/VCDashboard.jsx — InlineAnalysis FFI chart: change `<XAxis dataKey="name" .../>` to `dataKey="full"` (full faculty names), set `angle={-45}`, keep `textAnchor="end"` and `interval={0}`, and increase `bottomMargin` so full names fit (e.g. `chartData.length > 10 ? 80 : chartData.length > 5 ? 62 : 46`). Recolor each `<Cell fill>` to two bands: `e.FFI >= 4 ? "#10b981" : "#f59e0b"`. Update the FFITooltip color+label to the same two bands ('Good' >=4.0 / 'Needs Attention' <4.0); tooltip already uses d.full (keep). Replace the existing 4-swatch legend block with a 2-swatch legend: green = 'FFI >= 4.0 (Good)', amber = 'FFI < 4.0'. Add `import ProVCCommentPanel from '../components/ProVCCommentPanel';` (toast is already imported).

Modify src/pages/VCDashboard.jsx — InlineAnalysis 'Need Attention — by Faculty': add state `const [commentReport, setCommentReport] = useState(null);` inside InlineAnalysis. On each faculty row's header (the flex row with the `{r.subjectCode} · FFI` chip), add a 'Pro-VC Comments' button on the RIGHT side (after the chip) that calls `setCommentReport({ _id: r._id, facultyName: r.facultyName, subjectCode: r.subjectCode, courseName: r.programme, academicYear: r.academicYear })`. At the end of InlineAnalysis's returned JSX, render `<ProVCCommentPanel open={!!commentReport} onClose={() => setCommentReport(null)} reportId={commentReport?._id} facultyName={commentReport?.facultyName} subjectCode={commentReport?.subjectCode} courseName={commentReport?.courseName} academicYear={commentReport?.academicYear} />`. Keep all existing attention-comment rendering unchanged.

Modify src/pages/SubmissionDetail.jsx — Full View redesign: improve card styling, spacing, typography, color use and overall layout for a modern/professional look. Keep using the existing utility classes .card / .section-title / .table-header / .scrollbar-thin (defined in src/index.css) and add Tailwind refinements (rounded-2xl, shadow, gradient header, consistent padding/typography). Preserve ALL existing data, columns (S.No, Faculty Name, Subject Code, Course Name, Sem, Year, FFI, Resp.%, Appreciation, Needs Attention, Action Taken) and behavior (approve/reject, chart click-to-jump, ?report= highlight, PDF link). Do not remove anything.

Modify src/pages/SubmissionDetail.jsx — Full View FFI chart: same change as the VCDashboard chart — `dataKey="full"`, `angle={-45}`, larger `bottomMargin` (e.g. `chartData.length > 10 ? 80 : chartData.length > 5 ? 62 : 46`), 2-band Cell colors (`e.FFI >= 4 ? "#10b981" : "#f59e0b"`), update the inline tooltip color+label to two bands, and replace the 4-swatch legend with the 2-swatch legend (green >=4.0 Good / amber <4.0). Tooltip already uses d.full.

Modify src/pages/SubmissionDetail.jsx — add Action Taken button: in the Back & Actions row (where Approve/Reject live), add an 'Action Taken' button that opens a small inline modal (or prompt) capturing text, then `api.patch('/api/submissions/' + id + '/action-taken', { actionTaken: autoNumber(comment) })` (autoNumber already exists in this file), toast.success('Action taken saved') and refresh submission state; toast.error on failure. Reuse the existing endpoint exactly — do NOT create a new backend route. Mirror VCDashboard's handleActionTakenSave behavior.

Modify src/pages/SubmissionDetail.jsx — add Pro-VC Comments buttons + panel: add `import ProVCCommentPanel from '../components/ProVCCommentPanel';` and state `const [commentReport, setCommentReport] = useState(null);`. In the actions row, add a 'Pro-VC Comments' button beside the Action Taken button that opens the panel for the first report in submission.reports (setCommentReport with that report's _id/facultyName/subjectCode/programme/academicYear). In the Faculty Reports table, add a per-row 'Pro-VC Comments' button (each row = one faculty+course) that opens the panel for that row's r._id — this is how comments stay linked to the exact faculty+course. Both buttons share one `<ProVCCommentPanel open={!!commentReport} onClose={...} reportId={commentReport?._id} ... />` rendered at the end of the component.

Commit locally (never push): from repo root stage ONLY the files this FEAT modified: `git add src/components/ProVCCommentPanel.jsx src/pages/VCDashboard.jsx src/pages/SubmissionDetail.jsx && git commit -m "feat: Pro-VC comments panel, full-name FFI charts, Full View redesign"`. Do NOT git add . (the root repo has pre-existing uncommitted WIP in these same files plus untracked .agents/ artifacts that must not be swept in).
acceptance_criteria: src/components/ProVCCommentPanel.jsx exists, is a right-side createPortal overlay, shows faculty name + course at top, lists existing comments from GET /api/provc-comments/:reportId, lets the Pro-VC write+save via POST, shows a success toast and refreshes the list — and contains no hardcoded/dummy comments.

Both FFI charts (VCDashboard InlineAnalysis and SubmissionDetail Full View) use dataKey="full" (full faculty names), rotated ~-45deg, with a 2-band legend (green = FFI >= 4.0 Good, amber = FFI < 4.0) and matching 2-band bar colors.
VCDashboard 'Need Attention — by Faculty' shows a Pro-VC Comments button on the right of each faculty row that opens the panel scoped to that report's faculty+course.

SubmissionDetail (Full View) is visually redesigned (modern/professional, improved spacing/typography/color), still shows all existing data/columns, and has an Action Taken button (reusing PATCH /api/submissions/:id/action-taken) plus a Pro-VC Comments button beside it (header, first report) and per-row Pro-VC Comments buttons in the reports table.

`npm run build` in the repo root exits 0 with no build-breaking errors, and no existing dashboard feature (Submissions tab, HOD Status tab, Summary PDF, approve/reject, Analyse expand, signature upload) was removed.
verification: From repo root run: npm run build   (must exit 0; the new component + edited pages must compile cleanly)

Manually confirm by reading the final files: ProVCCommentPanel calls GET/POST /api/provc-comments/:reportId and stores no dummy data; both charts use dataKey="full" + 2-band legend; Full View still renders all original columns and the approve/reject/analyse/summary features remain.
